title: Average pages per author country
statementMd:
Average book length per author country, rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `country`, `avg_pages`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.country, ROUND(AVG(b.pages), 1) AS avg_pages FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id GROUP BY a.country;
```
